units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 22:15">Targ. Ps. XXII, 15</cite> Ms., v. <cite ref="Q01964"><he>פַּרְפֵּר</he> I</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 74b:4">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>דמִפְּרִיר</he> (Ms. M. <he>דמִיפְּרַךְ</he>; Ms. O. <he>דמִיפְּרַד</he>), v. <cite ref="O01082"><he>סְמִידָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Nedarim 73a:1">Ned. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>לכי שמע לֵיפֵר לה הוא</he> when he hears of the vow, why does he not disallow it himself (what need has he of the agent)? <cite ref="Nedarim 70a:1">Ib. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מצי מֵיפַר</he> he has no power to invalidate her vows.
<cite ref="Nedarim 70b:2">Ib. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מצי מיפר אב</he> her father has no power &c.; a. e.
